exercises.title: Past Simple — Verifica argomento
exercises.description: Verifica autonoma su azioni concluse, forme regolari e irregolari, was/were, negative, domande e sequenza narrativa.
exercises.instructions: Completa senza aiuti. Il feedback arriva soltanto alla fine.

sections.title: Verifica argomento
sections.instructions: Leggi il contesto completo e controlla sia il significato sia la forma del passato.

questions.title: Item 1
questions.prompt: Yesterday Marta missed the bus, so she walked to school.
questions.instructions: Choose the sentence that correctly reports the completed event.
questions.learning_objective: Recognise Past Simple for a completed event at a finished past time.

options.text: She did walked to school yesterday.

feedback.explanation: Finished past time + completed action: walked.

questions.title: Item 2
questions.instructions: Write the correct Past Simple forms.
questions.learning_objective: Produce regular, irregular and be forms in a connected past narrative.

content.text_template: Last Saturday we [[blank_1]] (be) in Florence. We [[blank_2]] (visit) a museum, [[blank_3]] (have) lunch near the river and [[blank_4]] (go) home at nine.

feedback.explanation: Were, visited, had, went form one completed sequence.

questions.title: Item 3
questions.prompt: Correct: We didn't went out because it rained all evening.
questions.learning_objective: Use the base verb after didn't.

accepted_answers: We didn't go out because it rained all evening.
We did not go out because it rained all evening.

feedback.explanation: Didn't already marks the past, so the main verb is go.

questions.title: Item 4
questions.prompt: Put the words in the correct order.
questions.learning_objective: Build a Past Simple information question with did and base form.

feedback.explanation: Where did your parents stay last weekend?

questions.title: Item 5
questions.instructions: Choose the forms that fit the past situation.
questions.learning_objective: Use was/were and a Past Simple short response accurately.

content.text_template: A: [[blank_1]] you at home last night? B: No, I [[blank_2]]. I was at the cinema.

feedback.explanation: With be: Were you...? No, I wasn't.

questions.title: Item 6
questions.instructions: There may be more than one correct answer.
questions.learning_objective: Discriminate correct affirmative, negative, question and be forms.

options.text: She bought a new laptop last month.
They weren't at school on Monday.
He didn't studied for the test.

feedback.explanation: After did/didn't use the base form; be has its own past forms.

questions.title: Item 7
questions.learning_objective: Ask naturally for a specific detail about a completed past event.

content.scenario: Two classmates talk about the weekend.

turns.speaker: Luca
turns.text: I went to a concert on Saturday.

feedback.explanation: Did + subject + base verb for the past question.

questions.title: Item 8
questions.prompt: Ieri siamo arrivati tardi, abbiamo perso l'inizio del film e poi abbiamo preso un taxi per tornare a casa.
questions.learning_objective: Produce a coherent sequence with regular and irregular Past Simple forms.

accepted_answers: Yesterday we arrived late, missed the beginning of the film and then took a taxi home.
Yesterday we arrived late, missed the start of the movie and then took a taxi home.
Yesterday we arrived late, we missed the beginning of the film and then we took a taxi home.

feedback.explanation: Arrived/missed are regular; took is irregular; all belong to one finished sequence.

questions.title: Item 9
questions.instructions: Write the correct Past Simple forms.
questions.learning_objective: Apply common spelling changes in regular Past Simple verbs.

content.text_template: Yesterday Mia [[blank_1]] (study) until six, [[blank_2]] (stop) for dinner and [[blank_3]] (plan) the next day's work.

feedback.explanation: Study → studied; stop → stopped; plan → planned.

questions.title: Item 10
questions.prompt: Dove eri ieri sera? Non ero a casa: sono andato in biblioteca, ma non ho trovato il libro che cercavo.
questions.instructions: Translate the complete context into English.
questions.learning_objective: Combine be questions, be negatives, irregular affirmative and did-negative forms in connected production.

accepted_answers: Where were you last night? I wasn't at home: I went to the library, but I didn't find the book I was looking for.
Where were you yesterday evening? I was not at home: I went to the library, but I did not find the book I was looking for.

feedback.explanation: Were you...? I wasn't... I went... I didn't find...
